x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: The selected authentication flow cannot reuse sufficient local credentials and must contact its identity provider or metadata service.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: authentication
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: The selected OAuth identity has no reusable authorization and requires a human browser/device authorization step, which JSON mode suppresses.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: authentication
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: Authentication completed using existing locally available credentials without persisting a new token.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: authentication
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: Authentication obtained and successfully persisted a new or refreshed local token.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: version_request
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: After applying the selector and --cached policy, at least one requested immutable version cannot be resolved from local snapshots and must be fetched from Firebase.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: external_editor
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: Completing the requested command requires launching an external editor, which JSON mode does not launch.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: promotion_selection
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: The promotion plan contains eligible items but the invocation supplies neither an explicit non-interactive selection nor an authorization that selects them.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: confirmation
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: The completed plan requires confirmation and the invocation has not supplied the command's confirmation-bypass option.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: confirmation
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: The command reached a confirmation-guarded effect because the invocation supplied the bypass option or the completed plan did not require confirmation.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: profile_bootstrap
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: No explicit or persisted effective profile can provide envelope context, so final envelope construction attempts to create the default profile directories and global configuration.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: profile_cache
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: The old profile has a local cache directory and the destination profile has no cache directory, so profile rename moves the old cache tree.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: project_registry
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: A non-cached project resolution reached a missing or empty live project registry and therefore had to contact Firebase before resolving the requested project.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: project_registry
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: A missing or empty live project registry was synchronized from Firebase and the synchronized registry was successfully persisted locally.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: import_strategy
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: The import target contains current Remote Config content and the invocation supplies neither --merge nor --override, so JSON mode must request an explicit strategy.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: import_merge_resolution
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: An explicitly selected merge produced at least one unresolved conflict and the invocation supplies no --merge-resolve value.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: draft_change_note
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: draft publish received an explicit change note and successfully persisted it to the local draft before continuing publication.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: diagnostic_cache_probe
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: Doctor successfully created its temporary cache probe file.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: diagnostic_cache_probe
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: Doctor successfully removed the temporary cache probe file it created.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: diagnostic_identity
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: Doctor resolved a locally usable configured identity with which it can attempt its Firebase diagnostic read.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: quota_project_credentials
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: Resolving a gcloud identity's ADC quota_project_id may need to contact the metadata service because no higher-precedence environment, project, or auth quota project is configured.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: theme_source
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: The theme import source uses an HTTP or HTTPS URL and therefore requires a network download.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: theme_source
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: The selected theme import source is a directory batch, so repeated imports preserve existing destinations and skip them with warnings.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: theme_source
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: The selected theme import source is one file, URL, or TOML stdin document, so an existing destination makes a repeated import fail.

x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.name: credential_file
x-fbrcm-runtime-state-semantics.semantics: The command successfully created or replaced the OAuth client-secret or service-account credential file.
